suggestions.assertion: The new doc follows the house structure ... instead of the skill's default catalog
suggestions.reason: The assertion would pass even though the executor added several sections absent from DD-2026-007 (Glossário, Objetivos e fora de escopo, a dedicated Alternativas table, Questões em aberto). Here the additions are sensible and the core house sections are intact, so the pass is justified — but the assertion does not actually test fidelity to the house template's section *set*. If strict template conformance matters, consider an assertion that the doc adds no sections beyond the house pattern (or only ones explicitly justified by the prompt). As written, a doc that bolted on a large default-catalog scaffold could still pass.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are well-targeted and discriminating overall — they jointly catch the hardest things (continuing the ID convention, dropping the retracted risk while keeping the real one, the Black Friday cost-with-mitigation). All 7 pass on genuine substance. The one gap is that 'follows the house structure' checks presence of the right sections but not the absence of extra/default ones.
